name: Ultimate Medical Academy
sourceNote: Condensed implementation profile derived from the 2023 UMA Full Brand Guide V3.

contentRules: Use a supportive, clear, student-centered tone.
Frame challenges as practical problems with paths forward.
Break complex information into focused steps that reduce cognitive load.
Use realistic scenarios and direct application rather than generic motivation.
Use active voice and plain language with a Flesch-Kincaid grade 8 target.
Keep the tone warm, direct, and conversational rather than overly formal.
Use examples and details relevant to entry-level allied healthcare roles when the topic allows.
Avoid internal production notes, marketing jargon, and overly clever language.

typography.headline: Merriweather UltraBold Italic
rules: Use Merriweather UltraBold Italic for large titles, headlines, and callouts when available.
Use Roboto for subheads, body copy, paragraphs, buttons, and emphasized words.
Use Arial when Merriweather or Roboto are unavailable.
Do not introduce additional font families.

cta.name: Journey Green
cta.usage: Use for calls to action, buttons, and small icon highlights. Use Legend Blue text on Journey Green.

rules: Use primary brand blues for the majority of visual design.
Include at least one primary blue in every visual design.
Use secondary and tertiary colors only as supplements, highlights, or illustration details.
Do not use secondary colors by themselves as the main design color.
Use Legend Blue, Hero Blue, Horizon Blue, Integrity Gray, black, or white for text.
Do not use Journey Green for body text.

graphics: Use angular shapes such as triangles, rectangles, and squares to echo UMA logo geometry.
Use rounded corners selectively to add softness.
Use brand-blue color blocking for structure.
Use accent lines to highlight important content.
illustrations: Use organic shapes and lines for a softer human element.
Keep at least one UMA brand blue present.
Use Journey Green sparingly as a highlight.
icons: Keep icons readable at small sizes with less detail.
Use Hero Blue as the primary icon color, supported by Horizon Blue and sparse Journey Green.
photography: Represent diverse students, alumni, and professionals respectfully and accurately.
Keep environments appropriate, warm, friendly, and free of unnecessary distractions.
Use realistic props and modern technology where appropriate.
visualStyle.promptGuidance: UMA brand style: caring, optimistic, future-facing, supportive, and professional. Use Legend Blue #0D3553, Hero Blue #1D6BA6, and Horizon Blue #0095C8 as the dominant palette. Use Journey Green #15EAC4 only as a small highlight. Favor clean layouts, soft corners, angular blue color blocking, approachable realistic imagery, and accessible contrast. Avoid logos, watermarks, clutter, unreadable text, disrespectful imagery, and off-brand colors.

rules: Do not rely solely on color to convey meaning.
Keep layouts clean, focused, and easy to scan.
Support mobile-friendly, touch-friendly, and screen-reader-friendly experiences.
